title: REV'IT! Windproof Neck Tube
features: Windproof protection for neck and shoulders
Adjustable fit with secure closure system
description:
Designed to optimize interior helmet ergonomics and temperature regulation, the REV'IT! Windproof Neck Tube from REV'IT! keeps riders dry, focused, and comfortable across grueling saddle stints. Built with Hydrophilic Moisture-Wicking Core with Fast-Evaporating Air-Mesh Outer, it boasts an installation rating of 0.5 / 10 (Over-the-head ergonomic anatomical draft collar).

Engineered for all-season comfort, the REV'IT! Windproof Neck Tube from REV'IT! delivers exceptional moisture management and skin comfort, shielding riders from biting wind-chill and summer humidity.
